# Implementation Plan: Shareholder visibility MVP (read-only)

**Branch**: `main` | **Date**: 2026-04-08 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)  
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/main/spec.md`

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit.plan`. Phase 0–1 artifacts: [research.md](./research.md),
[data-model.md](./data-model.md), [quickstart.md](./quickstart.md), [contracts/](./contracts/).

## Summary

Deliver a **tenant-scoped, read-only shareholder portal slice**: authenticated users see holdings,
distributions, **dashboard summaries**, **securities context**, and **notices** for **one registrar
tenant** only, with **append-only audit** on configured reads. **Implemented stack**: **Next.js
(App Router)** in `frontend/` (presentation) and **FastAPI** in `backend/` with an **in-memory**
repository (PostgreSQL-ready); **dev header auth** pending OIDC. **pytest** proves API tenant
isolation. Aligns with PRD incremental rollout and constitution **v1.1.0** (polyglot boundaries,
multi-tenant, auditability—**no AI** in this slice).

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: TypeScript (strict), Node.js 22 LTS; Python 3.11+  
**Primary Dependencies**: Next.js (App Router), React, Tailwind CSS v4; FastAPI, Pydantic, Uvicorn  
**Storage**: In-memory dev store mirroring Postgres row shapes; `DATABASE_URL` reserved for
SQLAlchemy/asyncpg + PostgreSQL  
**Testing**: pytest + httpx `TestClient` for API; frontend ESLint; Next build for typecheck  
**Target Platform**: Linux containers or PaaS (deployment TBD); local dev Windows/macOS/Linux  
**Project Type**: **Split** web client + HTTP API (constitution **Engineering Posture: Polyglot &
Service Boundaries**)  
**Performance Goals**: Modest MVP latency for list endpoints; not load-tested  
**Constraints**: No cross-tenant reads; no shareholder PII in LLM prompts (N/A); audit append-only;
tenant branding/disclosures from **config**, not hard-coded single-market rules  
**Scale/Scope**: Read-only portal slice; payments, KYC workflows, and AI **deferred**

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

Verify against `.specify/memory/constitution.md` (Nautilus). Minimum gates:

- **Multi-tenant**: **PASS** — Spec and data model require `tenant_id` on tenant-owned rows; APIs
  bind session to one tenant; negative tests for cross-tenant access. Jurisdiction/residency handled as
  config + deployment concern ([research.md](./research.md) §8).
- **Audit / integrity**: **PASS** — `AuditEvent` append-only for shareholder read actions (P2);
  material payment/register mutations out of scope but schema reserved; no silent cross-line
  replication.
- **AI** (if applicable): **N/A / PASS** — No ML/LLM in this slice; no training on PII.
- **Six lines / data classification**: **PASS** — Shareholder PII stays in registrar portal projection;
  least-privilege; other lines not fed from this slice beyond future explicit contracts (none in MVP).
- **Velocity**: **PASS** — Vertical slice (read-only portal + audit + tenant display config stub);
  deferred scope explicitly listed in spec and research.
- **Polyglot (v1.1.0)**: **PASS** — Tenant checks and audit on **API**; CORS and dev headers
  documented; no browser-trusted tenant boundary.

**Gate result**: **PASS** — No entries required in Complexity Tracking.

## Constitution Check (post-design)

After completing [data-model.md](./data-model.md) and [contracts/](./contracts/):

- **Multi-tenant**: Still **PASS** — entities carry `tenant_id`; API contracts scoped to session tenant.
- **Audit / integrity**: Still **PASS** — audit entity defined append-only; metadata must stay
  redacted (see [quickstart.md](./quickstart.md)).
- **AI**: Still **PASS**.
- **Six lines / data classification**: Still **PASS**.
- **Velocity**: Still **PASS**.

### Source Code (repository root) — as implemented

```text
frontend/
├── src/
│   ├── app/                 # Next.js App Router (presentation only)
│   ├── components/        # Layout, navigation, institutional UI chrome
│   └── lib/api/           # Typed client + optional mocks
├── package.json
└── .env.example

backend/
├── app/
│   ├── routers/           # FastAPI routes (tenant-scoped, audited reads)
│   └── repositories/      # In-memory store (Postgres-ready)
├── tests/
└── requirements.txt
```

**Structure Decision**: **Split stack** — TypeScript **Next.js** in `frontend/` and **FastAPI** in
`backend/`, aligned with Constitution **Engineering Posture: Polyglot & Service Boundaries** (v1.1.0).
